paraphrase: Rom 1:19-21: what can be known of God is manifest to those who suppress the truth, for God has shown it to them; his invisible attributes, eternal power and divinity, are clearly seen from the creation of the world, understood through the things that are made, so that they are without excuse; for although they knew God, they did not glorify him as God.
